description: Choose which deferred tools (built-in and MCP) are loaded up front instead of waiting behind ToolSearch
name: delay-no-more

defer.description: Tools to put behind ToolSearch, so their schemas load only when the model asks for them. Same syntax as the eager option; a tool matching both is loaded up front. Names that match nothing are ignored. Takes effect for new sessions.
defer.title: Tools to defer

eager.description: Tools to keep out of ToolSearch, so their schemas are in the prompt from the first turn. Separate with commas or spaces. `*` matches any characters, e.g. WebSearch, mcp__github__*. Names that match nothing are ignored. Takes effect for new sessions.
eager.title: Tools to load up front

tools.description: Legacy name for eager, still honored. Tools listed here are added to those in eager. Prefer eager in new configuration.
tools.title: Tools to load up front (legacy)
